patch_description: Restructures the monolithic filter into a staged pipeline of small, composable stages (noise estimator, RTS smoother engine, inter-pass damper, adaptive-Q refinement, guarded final damper). The key structural change follows the recommendation: the moderate-alpha (0.65) zero-phase bilateral damper is moved between the two RTS passes — it removes ripple before the Q/4 refinement pass, whose minimum-variance smoothing then re-sharpens corners without reintroducing the removed ripple. The RTS engine is factored into a reusable function (eliminating the duplicated forward/backward code), process noise becomes locally adaptive via robust block-MAD statistics interpolated per sample, and the final damper keeps a correlation guard. This improves maintainability and targets slope-change/false-reversal metrics while keeping lag low.
